steps.note: The video focus promises that on a five minute recording with its captions written, no pass of the main thread while it plays takes 50ms or more, so a click or key during playback answers at once. Nothing measured it while the video played until 2026-11-16. The window stays SHOWN for the whole walk (behind the person's own windows), because a window at zero alpha is one AppKit and SwiftUI may draw less of. Measured that day at Next defaults: 20 seconds from the start, longest pass 10 to 13ms; 20 seconds across a cut, 12 to 19ms; no pass at or over 50ms in either.
Space, as a person starts it, and twenty seconds of the talk with its captions coming and going. Every pass from the key on is judged.
A cut in the middle of the talk, then twenty seconds from ten seconds before it, so the frames on both sides of the cut are read while it plays.
